# Kretopia

> Kretopia is the Creative Economy OS — the verified system of record and opportunity-execution layer for creative work. Creatives build a Creative Passport, claim verified credits, get matched to real opportunities with Scout, and act with Kreto, their AI Executive Producer.

Kretopia is where creative careers get built, verified, and paid. Members maintain a Kretopia Creative Passport (verified career record), discover fitting opportunities through Scout, take approved action with Kreto (AI Executive Producer), run projects in Studio, and invoice through KrePay.

## Core

- [Home](/): Kretopia — Where creativity lives.
- [Passport](/passport): Your verified Creative Passport and career record.
- [Search](/search): Search the creative universe — people, projects, credits, opportunities.
- [Scout](/scout): Opportunity intelligence — discovery, matching, explanation.
- [Kreto](/kreto): Your AI Executive Producer.
- [Perks](/perks): Membership benefits.

## About

Kretopia by Thrive Collective. Launch markets: Caribbean + Bali (Phase 1).
